name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Famous "Acey Burger" Specialty Cheeseburger
whyItWorks: Dan's Drive-In is a Montpelier roadside landmark. The signature Acey Burger features fresh, daily hand-pressed beef chuck, melted American cheese, and bacon on a soft sesame seed bun. Soft and high in bioavailable protein in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Acey Burger with light special sauce, and ask to hold the sliced tomato and raw onion rings if sensitive to acid or allium roughage.
watchOuts: Hold raw onions and tomato slices during sensitive phases
